name: Serve, third shot, play it out
summary: Serve deep, partner returns deep, server plays a third-shot drop or drive and the rally is played out live; score only the serving side's rallies.
setup: Server at the baseline, partner as receiver; the server serves every rally
Receiver returns deep and moves to the non-volley-zone line; the server chooses a drop or a drive on the third shot, then follows it in
Play the rally out live; after 10 rallies swap roles
Keep score as rallies won on serve and serve faults out of 10
success_criterion: Win at least 5 of 10 rallies on serve with at most 1 serve fault
safety_notes: Live rallies can include lobs: turn and run back for a lob, never backpedal. Stop if dizzy or in pain.
coach_rationale: (judgment) AN-01 counts rallies won on serve, so the drill practises the whole serving pattern (deep serve, third shot, move in) under live play and scores exactly that. Unverified coaching content until a human coach reviews the library (P15).
